name: NDA Securities Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, NDA Securities Ltd provides a range of capital market services.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
NDASL is in the business of providing stock broking services, primarily focusing on equities and retail participation in the Indian financial markets.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 8.48% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 10.2% over last 3 years.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -12.6%
Working capital days have increased from -2.85 days to 172 days
